00_hpo_tfm_custom_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Vaswani et al. (2017) + Orthogonal Attention Regularization (Thesis Proposal)
checked_mechanisms: Orthogonal attention regularization loss (lambda_ortho * ||A A^T - I||_F^2)
Clean 10-seed benchmarking with deterministic SEED protocol

01_hpo_tfm_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Vaswani et al. (NeurIPS 2017) - Attention Is All You Need
checked_mechanisms: Positional encoding (sinusoidal in benchmark, learned in HPO)
deviations: Regularization divergence: HPO searches and tunes GaussianNoise(0.01), but benchmark class deleted GaussianNoise layer
Heuristic temporal pooling head (cat([last_step, mean(dim=1)])) instead of canonical token projection

02_hpo_dec_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Vaswani et al. (NeurIPS 2017) / Radford et al. - Autoregressive Causal Decoder
deviations: Causal mask applied strictly across lookback history (L=96), crippling bidirectional history attention
Forecast horizon (H=48) is predicted simultaneously via generic 2-layer MLP head rather than autoregressive causal decoding

03_hpo_encdec_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Vaswani et al. (NeurIPS 2017) - Sequence to Sequence Cross-Attention
deviations: Decoder queries are 48 repeated copies of last encoder step instead of zero/label initialized sequence
Forecast head flattens H * d_model into single dense layer creating 786K parameters in head_fc1 alone

04_hpo_ifm_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Zhou et al. (AAAI 2021) - Informer: Beyond Efficient Transformer for Long Sequence Time-Series Forecasting
checked_mechanisms: ProbSparse Attention mechanism with O(L log L) complexity
deviations: ProbAttention ignores attn_mask parameter completely in tensor math (leaks future attention in decoder)
Decoder start token sliced from distilled encoder latent representation where temporal length is reduced by MaxPool1d
Forecast head flattens H * d_model instead of token-wise linear projection

05_hpo_afm_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Wu et al. (NeurIPS 2021) - Autoformer: Decomposing Transformers with Auto-Correlation
checked_mechanisms: Moving average series decomposition with edge replicate padding
AutoCorrelation mechanism via Wiener-Khinchin FFT delay aggregation
Progressive trend accumulation across decoder layers

06_hpo_ptst_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Nie et al. (ICLR 2023) - A Time Series is Worth 64 Words: Long-term Forecasting with Transformers
deviations: CRITICAL: In benchmark (06_tfm_ptst_pytorch.py L248-L252), self.revin(ch_out, mode="denorm") was deleted, causing raw z-score outputs to be MinMax-inverted (catastrophic MAE 7.295 kW, 13.62% negative predictions)
In HPO (06_hpo_ptst_pytorch.py), loss is computed on only 1 channel out of 28, leaving 96.4% of channel parameters with zero gradients
RevIN normalizes bounded cyclical calendar features (sine/cosine), distorting temporal anchors

07_hpo_itfm_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Liu et al. (ICLR 2024) - iTransformer: Inverted Transformers Are Effective for Time Series Forecasting
checked_mechanisms: Inverted tokens: transposes time into token dimension and variates into sequence dimension

08_hpo_timesnet_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Wu et al. (ICLR 2023) - TimesNet: Temporal 2D-Variation Modeling for General Time Series Analysis
checked_mechanisms: Adaptive period weighting via Softmax on FFT amplitudes
Time-axis linear projection Linear(lookback, horizon) and channel projection Linear(d_model, 1)

deviations: Regularization divergence: HPO tuned GaussianNoise(0.01) as primary anti-overfitting regularizer, but benchmark class deleted GaussianNoise layer
Generic 2-layer MLP head with temporal average pooling (torch.mean) instead of canonical sequence readout

10_hpo_gru_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Cho et al. (EMNLP 2014) - Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder-Decoder
deviations: Regularization divergence: HPO tuned GaussianNoise(0.05), but benchmark class accepts argument without instantiating or applying it
Generic 2-layer MLP head with temporal average pooling instead of canonical sequence readout

11_hpo_dlinear_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Zeng et al. (AAAI 2023) - Are Transformers Effective for Time Series Forecasting?
checked_mechanisms: Separate linear models for seasonal and trend components
deviations: Artificially isolated to univariate target only, dropping all 27 external features (temperatures, calendar, lags); canonical Zeng et al. (AAAI 2023) supports multivariate inputs via Channel Independence, artificially doubling prediction error (MAE 6.983 kW)

12_hpo_nlinear_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Zeng et al. (AAAI 2023) - Are Transformers Effective for Time Series Forecasting?
checked_mechanisms: Single linear mapping + addition of last lookback value
deviations: Artificially isolated to univariate target only, dropping all 27 external features; canonical Zeng et al. (AAAI 2023) supports multivariate inputs via Channel Independence, artificially degrading baseline (MAE 6.247 kW)

13_hpo_smamba_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Wang et al. (2024); Gu & Dao (2023) - Is Mamba Effective for Time Series Forecasting?
checked_mechanisms: Selective State Space Model (SSM) bidirectional scan in pure PyTorch
deviations: Scans sequentially along time steps instead of inverted variate tokens as specified in S-Mamba paper (Wang et al., 2024)
Generic 2-layer MLP head with temporal average pooling instead of linear time-axis projection

14_hpo_powermamba_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Menati et al. (2024) - PowerMamba: Dual-Path Selective State Space Model for Power Systems
checked_mechanisms: Series decomposition into seasonal and trend
deviations: Fails to implement canonical PowerMamba (Menati et al., 2024): lacks dual-path iMamba (transposed variate scan), lacks concatenated [T; S] fixed embedding, lacks composite fusion head [x_e; x_m; x_im; x_m (x) x_im], and lacks RevIN; implemented as toy shortcut (SeriesDecomp + 1D SSM + Linear + MLP head)

15_hpo_timemachine_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Ahamed & Cheng (2024) - TimeMachine: A Time Series is Worth 4 Mambas for Long-term Forecasting
deviations: Fails to implement canonical TimeMachine (Ahamed & Cheng, 2024): lacks 2-stage multi-scale embedding (n1 > n2), lacks quadruple-Mamba pyramid (2 fine + 2 coarse), lacks residual multi-scale projection head; implemented as single-scale ad-hoc sum of 2 time SSMs + 2 channel SSMs with MLP head

16_hpo_s4d_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Gu et al. (ICLR 2022) - Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces
checked_mechanisms: Diagonal state space transition matrix Lambda
Cauchy kernel evaluation via circular FFT convolution with 2L padding
deviations: Generic 2-layer MLP head with temporal average pooling instead of canonical sequence projection

17_hpo_xgboost.py.paper_reference: Chen & Guestrin (KDD 2016) - XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
checked_mechanisms: Direct multi-step forecasting with 48 independent GBDT estimators
Histogram tree method with GPU acceleration (tree_method="hist", device="cuda")

18_hpo_lightgbm.py.paper_reference: Ke et al. (NeurIPS 2017) - LightGBM: A Highly Efficient Gradient Boosting Decision Tree
checked_mechanisms: Direct multi-step forecasting with 48 independent GBDT estimators
Subsampling bagging properly enabled via subsample_freq=1
CPU multi-threaded mode (n_jobs=-1) preventing Linux CUDA OpenCL crashes

19_hpo_sarima.py.paper_reference: Box & Jenkins (1970) - Time Series Analysis: Forecasting and Control
checked_mechanisms: Seasonal ARIMA with period s=48 (24-hour cycle on 30-min data)
deviations: Truncated evaluation: MAX_TEST_WINDOWS = 200 evaluates only 2.8% of test set (200 of 7,010 windows)
Missing "seeds" and "summary" dictionary structure in JSON output, causing aggregate_benchmark.py to extract all NaNs across benchmark tables

20_hpo_mft_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Liu et al. (Nature Scientific Reports 2026) - Multi-scale fusion transformer for EV charging station load prediction
checked_mechanisms: 3M (Multi-scale Modeling Mechanism) with modulo scale-masks per head (stride = h + 1)
FAM (Feature-correlation Analysis Module) base weights from PCC on training split
MFM (Multi-variable Fusion Module) dynamic cross-attention between load query and external keys/values
LSTM decoder with dual pooling and MLP projection head

22_hpo_fedformer_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Zhou et al. (ICML 2022) - FEDformer: Frequency Enhanced Decomposed Transformer for Long-term Series Forecasting
checked_mechanisms: Multi-Head FourierBlock (FEB-f) with random frequency selection
Series decomposition and progressive trend accumulation

23_hpo_tcn_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Bai et al. (2018) - An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling

24_hpo_nhits_pytorch.py.paper_reference: Challu et al. (AAAI 2023) - N-HiTS: Neural Hierarchical Interpolation for Time Series Forecasting
checked_mechanisms: Hierarchical linear knot interpolation backcast (Interpolate(theta, L))
Parameter efficiency verified (~529K parameters instead of 2.2M)
